# art-sidebar-inset



<!-- Auto Generated Below -->


## Overview

Sidebar Inset — the `main` area beside an `art-sidebar`. With the `inset` sidebar variant it
floats as a rounded card on the sidebar-coloured frame.

## Slots

| Slot | Description                                                              |
| ---- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
|      | Page content (a top nav, a header with `art-sidebar-trigger`, the page). |


## Shadow Parts

| Part     | Description           |
| -------- | --------------------- |
| `"main"` | The `<main>` element. |
